hypothesis: A profile-scaled pose objective improves actual train precision relative to continuing Q from the same weights; validation benefit is not assumed
inputs: same2048 local train rows, relative13 features and frozen diagnostic3 normalization; residual output, ADR016 decoder
initialization: both arms load identical diagnostic4 capacity terminal weights; both reset optimizer and schedule identically
Q: mean sum six squared normalized teacher joint errors
POSE_A: mean(sum((p-p_target)^2)/0.002^2 + sum((R-R_target)^2)/(8*sin(deg2rad(1)/2)^2)); no Q term; smooth pose loss only
domain: finite_revolute_extension for training; unmodified strict limit validity for metrics; no output clipping or numerical solver
selection: terminal5000 only; no adaptive extension or validation selection
validation: full3600; local/wide and family strata, keep invalid rows in denominator
interpretation: one objective-package change in paired short fine-tuning; not proof that new objective is globally best; no three-seed product acceptance
